TOOLKIT

THE
ARSENAL

Industry-standard software. Professional-grade output. Every time.

Adobe
Premiere Pro
Primary NLE for multi-cam editing, colour workflows, audio sync, and platform-optimised export.
Final
Cut Pro
Apple's pro NLE for lightning-fast, timeline-driven edits — optimised for performance and clean delivery.
Adobe
After Effects
Motion graphics, VFX compositing, kinetic titles, and animated overlays that add cinematic polish.
Adobe
Illustrator
Vector graphics, logo creation, custom lower-thirds, and print-ready brand assets for video productions.
Adobe
Photoshop
Thumbnail design, photo compositing, retouching, and still-image assets crafted for maximum visual impact.
iZotope
RX 10
Professional audio repair — eliminates noise, hum, reverb, and clicks for broadcast-quality sound.
